Subject: ACME MSA redlines + signing preferences

Hi Logan / Karthik,

Thanks again for the call earlier. We reviewed the latest MSA and Order Form and attached a redline set (ACME_MSA_Redlines_20271118.pdf) with two items that affect execution order: a new payment security addendum (Section 9.3) and a restricted-data clause that triggers our CFO signoff for anything with PSPA language.

Request: can Redwood route the DocuSign envelope so our CFO (J. Morales) reviews and signs first, then our General Counsel (L. Hsu) countersigns? We'll need a witness step after signature for our internal audit. If Redwood needs a conditional routing (i.e., if payment-security clause remains), please confirm how you'll automate that in the envelope.

Also attaching an OrderForm-Acme_v3.docx with the final pricing cells updated. We need a clean copy (PDF) returned after execution for our records.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync if helpful.

Sam
Sam Trevor
Head of Procurement, Acme Corp
Attachments: ACME_MSA_Redlines_20271118.pdf (pdf), OrderForm-Acme_v3.docx (docx)

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear note and the attachments.

Plan:
- We will prepare a conditional DocuSign flow: if the PSPA/payment-security language is present (per your redline), the envelope will require sequential routing: Redwood CFO -> ACME CFO (J. Morales) -> ACME GC (L. Hsu) -> Witness. If the clause is removed, standard two-signature flow applies (Redwood COO -> ACME GC).
- Marissa (Legal Ops) will ingest your redlines and produce a clean MSA and final order form.
- Olga (Contracts) will own the DocuSign envelope setup and will include the conditional routing logic and witness role.
- Marcus (Finance) will confirm Redwood's signer authority for envelopes requiring CFO-level signoff.

Action items: Olga to confirm the envelope template and provide the envelope ID; Marissa to deliver a clean PDF back to you once countersigned. We'll also add a HubSpot activity with the final DocuSign link.

I can schedule a 20-min sync tomorrow if you want to walk the sequence through.

Thanks
Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks team — I reviewed the redlines. Two quick notes: 1) we accept the payment-security language with a minor alternate phrasing (see attached PDF for suggested clean language); 2) the restricted-data clause triggers the CFO approval threshold, so Marcus will need to be the Redwood signer when the PSPA language remains.

I will:
- Incorporate the accepted phrasing into the clean MSA.
- Produce a clean PDF and a DocuSign-ready DOCX for Olga by EOD tomorrow.

Olga — when you create the envelope, please add routing rules: conditional recipient path keyed to a hidden checkbox field ("PSPA_Applies"), sequential order: Marcus Lin (role: Redwood CFO, email: marcus_lin@redwood.com) -> ACME CFO (role: Recipient 2) -> ACME GC (role: Recipient 3) -> Witness (role: Recipient 4). If PSPA_Applies=false, route: Redwood COO (marissa_cole@redwood.com) -> ACME GC.

Attachments: MSA_clean_suggestion_20271118.pdf

-Marissa

- If PSPA_Applies=true: routing order = 1) Marcus Lin (Redwood CFO) - needs signature; 2) J. Morales (ACME CFO) - needs signature; 3) L. Hsu (ACME GC) - needs signature; 4) Audit Witness (email: audit_witness@acme.com) - needs signature
- If PSPA_Applies=false: routing order = 1) Marissa Cole (Redwood COO) - signature 2) L. Hsu (ACME GC)

I will attach the clean MSA and the updated Order Form to the envelope. Sam, can you confirm the ACME recipient emails for Morales and Hsu (I have j.morales@acme.com and l.hsu@acme.com) and confirm whether the witness should be internal to ACME or a third-party auditor?

I'll hold sending until I get your confirmation. If you approve, I can also set an automatic reminder cadence (48h, 96h) and include the final clean copy delivery to both parties as a completed document.

-Olga
